description: This file defines the class Zend_XmlRpc_Client_ServerProxy, which acts as a client-side proxy for XML-RPC calls within the Zend Framework. It provides method chaining for namespaced XML-RPC calls, and manages internal caching of nested namespace proxies.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Client_ServerProxy
classes.description: A proxy class facilitating namespaced XML-RPC method calls by chaining and internal caching.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the proxy with a client and an optional namespace.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Returns a new proxy instance for a nested namespace, utilizing caching to optimize repeated access.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Delegates method calls to the underlying client, applying the current namespace prefix.
